claims: Artemis II is the first crewed mission of NASA's Artemis program.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is scheduled to launch from Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis II will carry Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II will fly around the Moon and back.
Artemis II launch is scheduled for 6:24 p.m. EDT (10:24 p.m. GMT).
The mission goal of Artemis II is a crewed lunar flyby.
Backup launch opportunities for Artemis II are available around April 2–6, 2026.
Artemis III is planned for mid-2027.
Artemis III is a Moon Landing.
Artemis I successfully completed its mission in November 2022.
